record.source_closeout_reference: Ladder design-review mission LADDER_DESIGN_REVIEW_20260611; envelope and review document under docs/Factory/v3/ladder/design_review/; committed with the mission changes per the same_commit convention

mission.objective: Execute the mandatory ladder design review after two consecutive rung-2 duration failures: diagnose the failures from the two measured calibration points, propose a bottom-up scope-sizing rule, a scope-sufficiency precondition, restated rung classes, and the interrupt-record field set v2 per the adopted safe-hold-trigger principle; name adoption as open sponsor decision HDI-RUNG2-005 with options.

forbidden_scope: no amendment of DURATION_LADDER_PLAN.md or V3_OP_003_DECISION_PACK.md before adoption
no adoption of the review's own proposals
no rung envelope or rung execution
no validator, fixture, template, or skill changes
no POC-repo changes within this mission
no new approval or promotion language
no files outside the envelope list
allowed_commands: scoped git add, commit, and push at closeout

verification.summary: Advisory suite run at closeout after all authorized-file edits; results recorded below.

notes: The review proposes and adopts nothing: DURATION_LADDER_PLAN.md and the decision pack are untouched, and the adoption decision is named open with options rather than resolved, so the mandated review cannot silently become a criteria change.

All numeric proposals are derived from the two measured calibration points with the derivation shown (throughput, governance share, per-deliverable costs), so the sponsor can check the arithmetic against the cited closeouts.
The recommendation (Option A) follows the sponsor's recorded guidance rather than the cheaper-to-pass alternative; Option B's weakness against the decision pack's purpose is stated explicitly.
No halt or fallback trigger fired; all edits stayed inside the five authorized files.

friction_notes: The measured coefficients (calls per build waypoint, per evidence artifact, per checkpoint) are exactly the dataset MISSION_ECONOMICS_VOCABULARY.md anticipated; the economics lane decision now has its first usable inputs one rung earlier than planned.
Recording-mission boilerplate observation continues to accrue (fifth near-identical envelope); the template candidate remains parked.
false_positive_notes: None observed in this mission's advisory pass.
false_negative_notes: No false negatives observed after the advisory pass.

phase2_design_signals: Re-basing a pass criterion on measured evidence required only two calibration runs because the governance discipline made both runs fully instrumented by default — the cost of honest instrumentation was repaid at the first design review.

The scope-sufficiency precondition moves a failure mode from run time to envelope-review time, which is the cheapest place to catch it; this pattern (preconditions derived from measured coefficients) may generalize to other envelope classes.

Both failed runs improved mechanics scores while failing the same criterion, which is the signature of a mis-specified criterion rather than a flaky system; design reviews should look for that signature explicitly.
